sql: SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'Kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'Pull' LIMIT 20;
SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, title, desk, status, published_at, body FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, article, kind, created_at, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox WHERE id IN (SELECT VALUE id FROM factbox);
SELECT id, ->covers->topic.name AS topics FROM article WHERE id IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7, article:a10];
